messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: NeoAis discovery — proposed action plan & owners

Hi Aneela — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard, proposed milestones, and suggested owners so we can align on next steps. Please confirm or update anything below.

Pain points we heard
- High per-token cost for current on-prem pipeline; unpredictable burst costs during daily batch jobs.
- Latency spikes on peak query windows impacting UX for customer-facing assistants.
- Auditability/compliance: need clearer retention and key-management controls for regulated data.

Goals you shared
- Reduce inference unit cost by ~30% for production workloads.
- Achieve p95 inference latency < 350ms for 512-token requests.
- Full audit trail and KMS integration for PII-handling flows.

Success metrics
- Unit cost $/1000 tokens or equivalent benchmark saved vs baseline
- p95 latency target above
- SOC2 evidence + KMS integration completed in pilot environment

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MPA) — milestones, dates, owners
1) Pilot scope & data access — draft MPA doc and define dataset samples (complete by 2026-06-28) — Owner: Aneela / NeoAis
2) Provisioning & private env setup — Redwood Private staging with KMS integration (complete by 2026-07-05) — Owner: Karthik (Redwood infra)
3) Performance run & tuning — throughput/latency run, quantization experiments, cost analysis (complete by 2026-07-19) — Owner: Marissa (Redwood engagement)
4) Security review & compliance evidence exchange — SOC2/controls proofing, retention policies (complete by 2026-07-26) — Owner: NeoAis procurement/security
5) Decision checkpoint & commercial terms — pilot results review and next step (decision by 2026-08-02) — Owner: Aneela / Redwood commercial

Risks & mitigations
- Long procurement timelines: engage procurement early (looping Samir) and provide contract template.
- Data access delays: provide synthetic sample process if production data needs approvals.

Attachments included
- neoais_mpa_draft.xlsx (MPA milestone table)
- sow-draft.pdf (initial SOW outline)

Ask: please confirm the milestone owners and dates above by EOD Wednesday (2026-06-23). If that works, we’ll lock calendar blocks and circulate the editable MPA Google Doc.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

—

Logan — thanks for the thorough summary, this captures the call well. A few small updates from our side: 

- Milestone 1: we can commit to the dataset samples by 2026-06-30 (need additional time to scrub PII). Please mark that date.
- Milestone 2: we’d like to include an initial compliance questionnaire exchange during setup (Samir will drive).
- Milestone 4 (compliance): procurement asked if Redwood can provide a template evidence package for SOC2 mapping — Samir, can you confirm what you need from us?

Procurement timeline: our internal procurement window for a pilot is target 3 weeks after the SOW is accepted. I’ve looped Samir and procurement.

Confirmed owners: Aneela (NeoAis) owns the scope & decision; Samir will own procurement; Redwood owners look good to us.

Next steps: please update the MPA dates to reflect dataset samples by 2026-06-30 and we’ll confirm procurement milestones after Samir's assessment.

Thanks,
